**[P1] Defer rejected-record release after the scheduler is disabled**

When `_disabled` is set, this drops the newly built record from the return value. `_emit()` calls `schedule()` while holding its plugin lock, so the record can consequently be finalized as `_emit()` returns while that lock remains held. Customer values placed in the record may run `__del__`; concurrent finalizers that re-enter each other's plugin instances can recreate the cross-invocation lock inversion this deferral mechanism addresses. Return the rejected record for `_hook_frames.releases` to clear after all plugin locks are released, and cover the already-disabled path with a finalizer regression test.
